name: disputedesk
description: Chargeback and dispute desk for Jira Service Management, built on Atlassian Forge

scripts.format: prettier --write src test docs README.md manifest.yml package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test docs README.md manifest.yml package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test
